summary: Solid test suite with comprehensive unit test coverage and good workflow integration testing. Unit tests cover all major functions (26 tests across 11 describe blocks), manifest parsing for both package.json and requirements.txt, license classification logic, report formatting in 3 formats, error paths, and the full Invoke-LicenseCheck orchestration. Mocking of Get-DependencyLicense is correct. Workflow tests validate YAML structure, actionlint compliance, and run two realistic end-to-end act cases with exact output assertions. Strengths: clean organization, proper fixture management, good edge case coverage for version parsing and license classification, clear test names. Gaps: (1) Invoke-Main CLI entry point not directly unit-tested (tested indirectly via workflow), (2) Get-CleanVersion not tested in isolation, (3) workflow tests lack failure scenarios (both act cases test success paths; no test for failOnViolation gate actually causing a failure or error paths in the manifest/config), (4) output assertions are somewhat brittle (exact test count 26 hardcoded in workflow test). Would catch most regressions in core logic but misses coverage of failure modes in the CI/CD pipeline.
